ES_TEAMS_API_KEY.description: REQUIRED for commands that use the ES Teams TV API. Every bot owner uses their own key: create one at https://esteamstv.devs.surf/developers/api and paste it here. Never share or commit it.

PHONE_NUMBER.description: Your own WhatsApp number for pairing-code login, digits only with country code, no + or spaces (e.g. 2349037524605). Leave empty to log in by scanning a QR code instead.

SELF_URL.description: This service's own public URL (e.g. https://your-app.onrender.com). When set, the bot pings itself every 5 minutes to prevent free-tier hosts from spinning the service down after inactivity. Optional, but recommended on free-tier hosting.

SESSION_PATH.description: Folder to store the WhatsApp session in. If you attached a persistent disk (e.g. on Render), set this to that disk's exact mount path so pairing survives restarts -- otherwise the default is a folder relative to the app, which is wiped on every restart even with a disk attached elsewhere. Leave unset if using MONGODB_URI instead.

MONGODB_URI.description: Optional. MongoDB connection string used to store the WhatsApp session so you do not have to link again after every restart or redeploy. Recommended on hosts without a persistent disk.

SET_PROFILE_NAME.description: Optional. Set to true to let the bot rename your WhatsApp profile to ES TEAMS V1 a few minutes after connecting. Off by default.

AUTO_FOLLOW_CHANNELS.description: Optional. Set to false to stop the bot following the ES TEAMS WhatsApp channels after connecting. On by default (it waits a few minutes first).

MARK_ONLINE.description: Optional. Set to true to mark the account online as soon as the bot connects. Off by default.
